title: An Analysis of Social Biases Present in BERT Variants Across Multiple Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Template-based cloze tasks using sentence pseudo-likelihoods and Categorical Bias (CB) scores to evaluate the model's association between gendered attribute terms (e.g., men, women) and specific concept words (e.g., professions, behavioral adjectives).

Template-based cloze tasks using sentence pseudo-likelihoods and Categorical Bias (CB) scores to measure disparities in probability distributions when sentences are completed with terms denoting different religious affiliations.

Template-based probing using sentence pseudo-likelihoods to compare model probabilities across sentences filled with different demonyms, region names, or 'People from [X]' structures, paired with negative concept words.
